records.label: Minimal x86-64 Linux assembly example
records.description: Illustrative GNU as Intel-syntax source using Linux system-call conventions; target-specific and not a portable ABI.

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Illustrative GNU as Intel-syntax source using Linux system-call conventions; target-specific and not a portable ABI.

value.source:
.intel_syntax noprefix
.global _start
.section .text
_start:
  mov eax, 60
  xor edi, edi
  syscall
value.build: as --64 -o exit.o exit.s && ld -o exit exit.o
value.note: Exits with status 0; it does not print text.
